## Appearance

Winifred Tolley possesses a healthy, circular, pink-and-white complexion paired with cheerful, gentle brown eyes. Her blonde hair is styled into a rigid, tiny bun secured with an elastic band.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P35](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0035)_

## Personality

Winifred Tolley is known for having a venomous, sharp tongue alongside a compassionate heart, and she is untroubled by nerves. Pragmatic in her outlook, she accepts the inevitable once she is certain of it, and she holds an obsessive dedication to cleanliness. She harbors a strong hatred for men, frequently criticizing them and penalizing grandiloquent speech. Additionally, she holds crazy views and a sacred dread regarding [Methodists](../codex/factions.md#methodist). She possesses marvelous needlework skills and once baked award-winning lemon pies, while also finding enjoyment in reading newspaper death notices.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P26](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), +8 more_

## History

Miss Winifred Tolley spent time visiting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), offering her candid opinions on local neighbors, ministers, and parish gossip while hand-sewing baby clothing. She was familiar with the tragic history of the Vane family and shared [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's background with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), later reacting with initial anger before accepting Lorna's decision to take her afflicted husband to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal). Following the shocking revelation that Lorna's husband was actually his cousin [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md), Winifred discussed the news with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and encouraged her to inform [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) of Lorna's freedom. After announcing her intention to marry [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md), Winifred wed him and later adopted a young girl named [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) upon being approached by local children. Known for her frequent visits to [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to exchange community news with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), Winifred often voiced sharp critiques regarding the local minister's chaotic household and his children's unconventional behavior. However, after listening to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) passionately defend the minister's talented family, Winifred was inspired to alter her perspective. In time, she also took part in local discussions regarding upcoming weddings and the minister's plans for his children.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P37](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), +29 more_

## Quotes

> "She has altered considerably of late. Her laughter and jesting resemble those of a young girl, and based on what she says, I deduce she visits this place quite frequently."
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P25](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0025)

> "MR. Fiske, my lone brother passed away fifteen years back, and I’ve taken on no new ones since then. Regarding my Christian faith, I trust and believe I possessed it while you were still a toddler wearing petticoats."
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007)

> "Nell, are you trying to say that the rumors I’ve been hearing are factual—that Dr. Carrow informed Lorna that Rufus can be healed, and that she intends to bring him to Montreal so he can undergo surgery?"
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032)

> "Rufus Vane received the harm that resulted in his current state during a drunken brawl. His fate is DESERVED. It was inflicted upon him as a retribution. The doctor, I don’t believe, has any right to meddle with God’s visitations."
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P46](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0046)

> "Now, you don't need to call me Miss Winifred, my dear Nell. EVERYONE would have come to the identical conclusion. Should the physicians in Montreal succeed in transforming Rufus Vane into a sensible person, they are truly remarkable."
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P4](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--winifred-tolley.md)

Winifred maintains a friendly relationship with Adrian despite penalizing his grandiloquent speech. She assists him by dropping him off near his lodgings and interrupts his somber conversations with pragmatic comments. She also approves of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) staying with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during Adrian's visits to the area.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +9 more_

### [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lorna-vane--winifred-tolley.md)

Winifred is a close friend and supporter of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), spending time with her and sharing local stories and parish updates. When [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) decides to take Rufus to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for surgery, Winifred angrily confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over the choice, though she ultimately accepts Lorna's final decision.

### [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mary-stubbs--winifred-tolley.md)

Winifred acts as an authority figure and adoptive mother to [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md). After rescuing [Tessa Carrow](../character/tessa-carrow.md) from Mary's erratic behavior, Winifred interrogates Mary at the manse, urges Mr. Ashdown to address her upbringing, and ultimately agrees to adopt her to save her from returning to an asylum. She continues to oversee Mary's daily routines, such as her knitting, and sends her on errands.
